children: may retrace into a support zone of $4.72 to $5.02 per bushel before testing a resistance range of $5.40 to $5.45-1/4 in the fourth quarter.
A high-low bottom around $3.60-1/2 between August 2024 and August 2025 has been confirmed, suggesting a target around $6.40.
The current uptrend has been closely following two series of retracements, respectively on the downtrend from $8.27-1/4 and $7.29-1/2.
The resistance zone of $5.40 to $5.45-1/4 triggered a correction, the depth of which remains unknown. It is speculated to extend into the support range of $4.72 to $5.02.
A shallow correction may end around $5.02, as it might turn out to be a pullback toward the neckline of the high-low bottom.
A detailed study on the daily chart supports this speculation. The uptrend has been riding on a wave c, which may consist of five smaller waves.

The current fall is driven by a wave 4, which may end around $5.04-1/2, as indicated by a rising channel. This wave will be reversed by an upward wave 5, which is expected to travel to $5.70, the 161.8% projection level of the bigger wave c.
A break below $5.04-1/2 may be followed by a further drop toward $4.64-1/4, as indicated by a duplicated channel.
